directPricing.channel: ladeapp / QR / credit card, no charging card required

evidence.observed: Current page publishes spontaneous charging without card through ladeapp/QR and credit card: 1 EUR/session, 0.58 EUR/kWh AC, 0.68 EUR/kWh DC and 0.05 EUR/min.

Section 3.3 defines ad-hoc pricing effective 2025-05-01: 1 EUR/session; 0.58 EUR/kWh AC; 0.68 EUR/kWh DC; 0.05 EUR/min from minute 181 AC or 61 DC, charged 09:00-21:00; applies to the Stadtwerke Duisburg stations covered by section 3.1.
As of 2026-08-10 Stadtwerke Duisburg reports 478 charge points at 191 sites, confirming the operator remains current and active.

cpos.conclusion: Complete for direct/ad-hoc charging on Stadtwerke Duisburg-operated public stations under the official tariff contract. Roaming and subscriber-card prices remain separate.

cpos.operator: Stadtwerke Neuss Energie und Wasser GmbH

evidence.observed: Current official page publishes ad-hoc without card: AC 0.56 EUR/kWh + 5.90 EUR/session; DC 0.66 EUR/kWh + 9.90 EUR/session, gross including VAT; activation by scanning the station QR code. The page continues to present these as the operative Ladekarten-Tarife from 2023-01-01.
Official station overview embeds the smartlab/ladenetz map for Stadtwerke Neuss charging locations.

cpos.conclusion: Complete for the currently published direct/ad-hoc tariff. No unverified time or blocking component is added. Subscriber-card and home-charging tariffs are excluded.

evidence.observed: Since 2026-09-01 the RFID card is only an authentication alternative, not a discount product. The operator explicitly states there are no separate public tariff models and that the valid price is station-specific and shown in the app before charging.

Official FAQ says station costs can differ by location; app users must confirm the current price for the selected charge point, while ad-hoc users see and confirm tariff information on the station-specific ad-hoc page.
Official page confirms Stadtwerke Solingen operates its own public charging stations and documents location-specific access conditions.

cpos.reason: The current direct/ad-hoc price is explicitly station-specific and is only disclosed after selecting the EVSE in the app or station ad-hoc page. No safe network-wide amount exists.
cpos.neededToComplete: Enumerate the Stadtwerke Solingen EVSE IDs and capture each exact current app/ad-hoc tariff payload, including any energy, session, time or blocking component and its validity. Do not infer one network tariff.
cpos.conclusion: Partial/deferred after first pass; station-level exact-price harvesting is required.
